scope: FORGE native GitHub model-free development cycles only; completion-driven success-to-next workflow_dispatch and ten-minute safety fallback via existing integrated workflow schedule. No new cron scheduler. Existing schedule strict scientific ancestry for F124/F125/F127/F128 retained. workflow_dispatch is a non-scheduled development run and cannot masquerade as source-authenticated successive scheduled research.

mechanics.source: workflow_run completed event from the exact existing integrated synthetic workflow
mechanics.advance_if: Successful first attempt on main; source SHA equals current protected main; exact workflow path, prior run must have source-bound two-OS F124, F126 and F129 artifacts with provider digests; report predecessor evidence denial; no active or queued integrated run; approved bounded daily cap; no paused flag; no near scheduled fallback; completion job with actions:write permission performs a single workflow_dispatch to existing integrated workflow on main using GITHUB_TOKEN.
mechanics.no_advance_if: failed, cancelled, skipped, rerun, PR, push, wrong SHA, mismatched source, incomplete evidence, stale/duplicate artifact IDs, too many completions, active run, missing expiry/sha, near fallback schedule. No dispatch for a controller's own completion.
mechanics.serial: Dedicated completion-event controller workflow with fixed job-level concurrency and explicit no prior in-progress; integrated workflow existing global concurrency uses main ref, cancel-in-progress false.
mechanics.recovery: Change existing integrated workflow cron from 19 every six hours to 7,17,... every hour; schedule events preserve original authenticated science-development lineage; allow normal previous scheduled F124/F126 bootstrap and F125/F127, no promise of seven-minute actual completion.

tests: adversarial pure source-qualifying gate, no internet inside tests
reject PR, push, scheduled failure, workflow re-run, current/old source and source drift
reject partial/duplicate evidence and providers mismatched
reject active queued runs and fail closed on stale API pagination
enforce daily cap and pause flag
successful actual completed run grants one source-bound dispatch decision
never claim originals accepted, science first-use, two genuine scheduled cycles or optimizer promotion
budget: 96 completed development starts UTC day max, conservative to prevent unexpected runner use. Concurrency never more than one research run, though research matrix has 2 existing OS workers. User can disable via repository variable FORGE_DEV_AUTONOMY_PAUSE=true, optional without needing to configure variable to start.
